segments.snp4.8:1.1: Idheva suddhi iti vādayanti [vidiyanti (sī. pī.)], nāññesu dhammesu visuddhimāhu;
segments.snp4.8:1.3: Yaṃ nissitā tattha subhaṃ vadānā, paccekasaccesu puthū niviṭṭhā.
segments.snp4.8:2.1: Te vādakāmā parisaṃ vigayha, bālaṃ dahantī mithu aññamaññaṃ;
segments.snp4.8:2.3: Vadanti te aññasitā kathojjaṃ, pasaṃsakāmā kusalā vadānā.
segments.snp4.8:3.1: Yutto kathāyaṃ parisāya majjhe, pasaṃsamicchaṃ vinighāti hoti;
segments.snp4.8:3.3: Apāhatasmiṃ pana maṅku hoti, nindāya so kuppati randhamesī.
segments.snp4.8:4.3: Paridevati socati hīnavādo, upaccagā manti anutthunāti.
segments.snp4.8:5.1: Ete vivādā samaṇesu jātā, etesu ugghāti nighāti hoti;
segments.snp4.8:5.3: Etampi disvā virame kathojjaṃ, na haññadatthatthipasaṃsalābhā.
segments.snp4.8:6.1: Pasaṃsito vā pana tattha hoti, akkhāya vādaṃ parisāya majjhe;
segments.snp4.8:6.3: So hassatī uṇṇamatī [unnamatī (?)] ca tena, pappuyya tamatthaṃ yathā mano ahu.
segments.snp4.8:7.1: Yā uṇṇatī [unnatī (?)] sāssa vighātabhūmi, mānātimānaṃ vadate paneso;
segments.snp4.8:7.3: Etampi disvā na vivādayetha, na hi tena suddhiṃ kusalā vadanti.
segments.snp4.8:8.1: Sūro yathā rājakhādāya puṭṭho, abhigajjameti paṭisūramicchaṃ;
segments.snp4.8:8.3: Yeneva so tena palehi sūra, pubbeva natthi yadidaṃ yudhāya.
segments.snp4.8:9.1: Ye diṭṭhimuggayha vivādayanti [vivādiyanti (sī. pī.)], idameva saccanti ca vādayanti;
segments.snp4.8:9.3: Te tvaṃ vadassū na hi tedha atthi, vādamhi jāte paṭisenikattā.
segments.snp4.8:10.1: Visenikatvā pana ye caranti, diṭṭhīhi diṭṭhiṃ avirujjhamānā;
segments.snp4.8:10.3: Tesu tvaṃ kiṃ labhetho pasūra, yesīdha natthī paramuggahītaṃ.
segments.snp4.8:11.1: Atha tvaṃ pavitakkamāgamā, manasā diṭṭhigatāni cintayanto;
segments.snp4.8:11.3: Dhonena yugaṃ samāgamā, na hi tvaṃ sakkhasi sampayātaveti.

lines: 836-7. Chaṭṭhagāthāya attho – yasmā ca na haññadatthatthi pasaṃsalābhā, tasmā paramaṃ lābhaṃ labhantopi “sundaro ayan”ti tattha diṭṭhiyā pasaṃsito vā pana hoti taṃ vādaṃ parisāya majjhe dīpetvā, tato so tena jayatthena tuṭṭhiṃ vā dantavidaṃsakaṃ vā āpajjanto hasati, mānena ca uṇṇamati.
Yasmā taṃ jayatthaṃ pappuyya yathāmāno jāto, evaṃ uṇṇamato ca yā uṇṇatīti gāthā.
Tattha mānātimānaṃ vadate panesoti eso pana taṃ uṇṇatiṃ “vighātabhūmī”ti abujjhamāno mānañca atimānañca vadatiyeva.
Evaṃ vāde dosaṃ dassetvā idāni tassa vādaṃ asampaṭicchanto “sūro”ti gāthamāha.
Abhigajjameti paṭisūramicchanti yathā so paṭisūraṃ icchanto abhigajjanto eti, evaṃ diṭṭhigatiko diṭṭhigatikanti dasseti.
Yeneva so, tena palehīti yena so tuyhaṃ paṭisūro, tena gaccha.
Pubbeva natthi yadidaṃ yudhāyāti yaṃ pana idaṃ kilesajātaṃ yuddhāya siyā, taṃ etaṃ pubbeva natthi, bodhimūleyeva pahīnanti dasseti.
